description: This file defines an interface `IndexKey` for representing a MongoDB index key, including methods to retrieve the field name and the BsonValue defining the index type.

classes.name: IndexKey
classes.description: Interface for a MongoDB index key, providing methods to access the field name and BsonValue.

methods.name: getFieldName
methods.description: Returns the field name for the MongoDB index key.

methods.name: getBsonValue
methods.description: Returns the BsonValue that defines the type of the index key.
